question: In June 2025, which company was licensed to produce the Expandable Mobile Shelter for armed forces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Electronics Ltd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2025**, the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** entered into a **Licensing Agreement for Transfer of Technology (ToT)** with **Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL)** for the production of **Expandable Mobile Shelters (EMS)**.
 
• The **Expandable Mobile Shelter** is a specialized modular unit designed and developed by the **Research & Development Establishment (Engineers) [R&DE(E)]**, a premier laboratory of **DRDO** based in **Pune**.
 
• This technology transfer aims to enhance the **logistical capabilities** of the **Indian Armed Forces** by providing rapidly deployable and versatile infrastructure for field operations.
